title: Kineto Screenplay
description: A screenplay as structured production state; screenplay.md is rendered from it. Cast identifiers are story analysis character identifiers; scene identifiers are unique within the screenplay.

id.description: A character identifier from the story analysis.

name.description: The name dialogue is attributed to.

id.description: Stable across revisions; downstream work refers to the scene by it.

heading.description: The scene heading as the screenplay prints it, in the screenplay's language.

location.description: A location identifier from the story analysis.

time.description: Time of day or continuity, such as night or continuous.

characters.description: Cast identifiers of everyone present or heard in the scene.

dramatic_goal.description: What the scene must achieve dramatically, in one or two sentences.

character.description: Dialogue only: the cast identifier of who speaks.

parenthetical.description: Dialogue only: a short direction for the line, without parentheses.
